meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把杂乱难懂的代码拆解重组成清晰结构,让它更易读易改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有写乱或过时的代码想理清结构又不想改变行为
copy.tagline_en: Break messy code into a clearer structure without changing what it does
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your code feels tangled and you want cleaner structure without behavior changes

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按六个阶段重构代码：先澄清你的意图、并行探查代码库、绘制依赖关系图、评估测试覆盖，再生成分步计划，逐步执行且每步后跑测试验证，失败就回退。
howto.when: 当你要求重构、简化、抽取代码等操作时触发；也可用 /refactor <目标> 命令，配 --scope、--strategy 等选项指定范围与风险策略。

say.text: 把 AuthService 类里的校验逻辑抽成独立模块
say.note: 会先确认目标，再进入代码库分析流程。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs a six-phase refactor: it clarifies intent, explores the codebase, maps dependencies, assesses test coverage, plans steps, then executes and verifies each step with tests, reverting on failure.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to refactor, simplify, extract, or do similar code work; you can also call /refactor <target> with --scope and --strategy options.

say_en.note: Refactors only that file; safe strategy by default.

say_en.text: Extract the validation logic in AuthService into its own module
say_en.note: Confirms the goal first, then starts codebase analysis.
Widens change scope; needs adequate coverage.
